descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S15 「第 5 步（有闸门）：点 Generate，然后重新加载、离开、锁屏或把 app 切到后台 30 s 再回来——看到记录、「generating」状态或明确的失败，绝不是空白（web 和手机；S21 并到这里）」 Step 5 (gated): tap Generate, then reload, leave, lock the phone or background the app for 30 s and return — the note, a 'generating' state, or an explicit failure, never blank (web and phone; S21 merged here)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Start Generate, then lock the phone, background the app, or reload the tab for 30 s and return: the note is present or an explicit failure shows, never a blank screen or silence; …（UAT OAT-03 step 5；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 2；UAT 3.5；TFA-92592 AC 15） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android（UAT 3.3；UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident, each with an encounter dictation typed. Phone cells: an iOS and an Android build under the same rules as S20 (which builds and accounts may be used)

When Tap Generate Note & Finish, reload at once (or open another patient), wait 30 s, return to the chart and open Post-Round. Phone cells: tap Generate Note & Finish, lock the phone 30 s (iOS) / background the app 30 s (Android), unlock and return

Then The note is there; or a 'generating' state while it still runs, then the note; or an explicit failure with the dictation kept. Never an empty Post-Round tab with no state; the same on the phone, never a blank screen or silence

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Each web checkpoint mustContain the patient and one of: the note heading, 'generating', or the failure message; Post-Round with none of them = Fail. Phone cells: the tester's screenshot on return judged against Expected Result 2. Whether 'generating' alone passes is Q9. Gated: TFA-92592 AC 15 is not on main, so a Fail reports as Blocked. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
